items.t: I just wanted to say I’m really glad you wrote “Too Much & Not Enough.” I’ve been slowly making my way through the book (occasionally have had to reread some sections because dissociation and memory loss issues. My memory is as bad as Dory’s from Finding Nemo lol), and I really appreciate the approach you’ve taken with the book. It’s compassionate, and it’s not condescending. There are moments you describe that are relatable (especially the hypervigilance, I had a hypervigilance phase and even now I still have days where I slip back into that mindset. 0/10 do not recommend /lighthearted). There are parts that have made me reflect on my relationship with my ex (who was emotionally and psychologically abusive, and because I pinned every hurt feeling I had to my BPD it took me longer to realize than I would’ve otherwise that I was being abused). There are healthy coping skills I developed recently that I recognized but until I read your book I didn’t realize were DBT. There were also skills I haven’t known about or used before that I now want to try out. I’m only roughly ¾ths of the way through, and I expect to reread some sections again anyway to refresh my memory, but I can’t thank you enough for writing this book. You created something wonderful, and I’m really looking forward to your next book. Take care!!
